parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence remains after the 2018 cross-dressing ruling, and no universal facility, border or custody ban is documented, which raises the score. Against that, police are documented using residual clauses to extort LGBT people, complainants face secondary discrimination, and a trans woman was stabbed and then denied court access (2017, pre-ruling). The 69 violence cases (2018-2022) are a raw count without denominator, so they show pattern and official concern, not a measurable rate, and the 2019 beating was condemned by the ministry. No hate-crime recourse is documented. The life-imprisonment same-sex statute is rarely enforced; per rubric it is secondary where 2022 polling shows 72% acceptance/tolerance and pride proceeds under police protection. Extrapolating from police extortion plus thin recourse, with undocumented visitor facilities/custody as open questions, places this in Elevated Risk above unremedied universal-exposure cases.
